judgment_text:
WP Crl. No. 870 of 2025

The Order of the Court was delivered by

Dr Anita Sumanth, J.:— The learned counsel for the petitioner does not wish to pursue this writ petition as his subsequent request for leave, filed after institution of the writ petition has been accepted under order dated 27-2-2026.

2. Recording the above, this writ petition is closed. No Costs.
